technical.execution_assumption: signal at close; position change at that close; following close-to-close return counted; no look-ahead; final positions liquidated for comparison
technical.fee_assumption_note: Assumed 0.15% per side is charged on strategy position changes and benchmark entry/exit; replace with verified transaction costs before using as a live performance estimate.

fundamental.important_note: Official NAV same-session anchors are excluded; they reproduce the official NAV and are not independent forecasts.

limitations: EMA20/EMA50 is a transparent baseline, not an optimized strategy or investment recommendation.
Historical backtest does not guarantee future performance; the number of completed trades is reported and may be small.
Transaction cost is an explicit assumption, not a verified fee schedule.
Official-NAV-anchored values are not treated as independent fundamental forecasts.
Fundamental forecast accuracy remains pending until independent same-session estimates can be compared with official NAV.
